findings.reason: T-3 line 33 asserts only that `nio flow done` "for its stage refuses (raises or exits non-zero) with history.jsonl unchanged", and names no stage or message. In today's `done` (src/nio/flow.py), `done spec_jury` raises from `guard` ("has no guard to run") because `skips` already contains spec_jury on a lite header. `done tasking` fails its guard on the missing tasks.md and, outside auto mode, writes nothing. So either reading passes before the fix, and the assertion proves nothing about the route refusal EB-3 adds.

findings.reason: T-1 (tasks.md line 13) must assert "no route-change stop" before T-3 exists. Neither the task nor the spec gives that stop any wording or marker: EB-3 and AC-3 say only that `nio flow next` "names the recorded and the header route", and AC-5's observable says just "no stop". A wrong refusal shaped like today's unsupported-route output from `next_step` would also print no `(lite route)` line, so the one concrete assertion in T-1 would not catch it.
